offers.title: Free phone and monthly service through Lifeline (SAMPLE OFFER)
offers.summary: If you qualify for Lifeline, many participating providers offer a free smartphone with free monthly talk, text, and data. A phone makes it easier to stay connected to your recovery supports, appointments, and job searches.
offers.who_qualifies: Household income at or below 135% of the federal poverty guideline, or you get SNAP, Medicaid/MassHealth, SSI, Federal Public Housing Assistance, or the Veterans Pension.
offers.link_label: Learn more and apply at Lifeline Support
